title: Trading and the Oakvale stash
changes: Trade with other players: open Group (P) and press Trade next to a hero close by, or type /trade name in chat.
Each side puts up items from the bag and gold. The swap only happens when both press Ready, and any change takes back both Ready marks.
A stash chest now stands on the Oakvale market square. It holds 24 items and your gold, shared by all heroes of your account.
Items for other classes now stay in your bag when you log out, so you can pass gear between your heroes.
